proceeding: In the Matter of the Application of Union Electric Company d/b/a Ameren Missouri for Approval of New Modified Tariffs for Service to Large Load Customers
how_obtained: Found the filing through the Missouri EFIS case search. The search form at /Case/Search posts with an ASP.NET antiforgery token, so I fetched that page with a cookie jar, read the token out of the HTML, and POSTed SubmissionNumber=ET-2025-0184 with IsIndividualFilingSearch=true. The JSON reply carries a results grid of /Case/FilingDisplay/<id> links; each of those pages lists its attachments as /Document/Display/<id>, which serves the PDF publicly with no login. Downloaded the PDF with curl and extracted text with PyMuPDF sorted-block extraction (page.get_text('text', sort=True)), pages joined with a form feed (\x0c). No cleaning, reflow, de-hyphenation or whitespace normalisation.
filer: Joint signatories: Ameren Missouri, Amazon Data Services Inc., Evergy, MO PSC Staff and others
notes: Three changes from the 2025-11-07 original: the title gains the word CORRECTED, the certificate of service date moves from the 7th to the 9th, and a 28th page is added carrying Exhibit A, the Schedule LLCS Initial Pricing table (Customer $412.66, Demand $22.43 summer / $10.66 non-summer, Energy $0.0406 / $0.0371, Reactive $0.4481). A version diff that only compares prose would miss the entire rate table.
